initialize.instructions: Use this server to interact with the ZAP API for security testing.

tools.name: zap_scan_history_list
tools.description: List recent scan history and release-evidence entries, including queued scans, direct scan starts, and generated report artifacts.

evidenceType.description: Optional evidence type filter: scan_job, scan_run, or report_artifact

status.description: Optional status filter such as queued, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled, started, or generated

target.description: Optional target or artifact substring filter

limit.description: Optional maximum entries to return, bounded by server configuration

tools.name: zap_findings_summary
tools.description: Get the first-pass findings view after a scan or passive-scan wait. This returns a concise grouped risk summary for fast triage. Requires a nonblank target baseUrl covered by scan evidence visible to the caller.

baseUrl.description: Required nonblank target base URL covered by scan evidence visible to the caller, for example https://app.example.com/admin

tools.name: zap_attack_status
tools.description: Get status for a guided active-scan operation.

operationId.description: Guided attack operation ID returned by zap_attack_start

tools.name: zap_auth_session_prepare
tools.description: Prepare a guided auth session from an operator-managed profile. Use a kind=browser profile for Client Spider, or kind=form for HTTP spider and active scans. The requested target must remain on the profile's authorized origin.

targetUrl.description: Target URL on the profile's authorized origin; paths may vary

tools.name: zap_scan_history_release_evidence
tools.description: Export a release or pilot handoff evidence bundle with summary counts, target coverage, warnings, and bounded ledger entries.

releaseName.description: Optional release, pilot, or handoff label included in the exported bundle

target.description: Optional target or artifact substring filter for the evidence window

limit.description: Optional maximum entries to export, bounded by server configuration

tools.name: zap_attack_start
tools.description: Start a guided active scan for a specific target host or base URL after crawl/import setup. The server decides direct versus queued execution from deployment topology. When authSessionId is supplied, guided attack currently accepts prepared form-login sessions only.

targetUrl.description: Target host or base URL to attack, for example https://app.example.com or https://app.example.com/api

policy.description: Optional active-scan policy name when you need a non-default rule set

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key used only when guided execution selects queued mode; ignored in direct mode.

authSessionId.description: Optional prepared auth session ID from zap_auth_session_prepare. Guided attack currently accepts form-login sessions only.

tools.name: zap_target_import
tools.description:
Import an OpenAPI/Swagger definition, GraphQL schema, or SOAP WSDL to prepare API endpoints for testing.
Use when you have an API definition; use zap_crawl_start to discover ordinary web pages.
Requires a reachable, configured ZAP instance with the matching OpenAPI, GraphQL, or SOAP add-on.
Import changes the current ZAP session and may send requests to the definition source and API targets;
use only authorized targets. It does not start an active scan: after reviewing import messages,
call zap_attack_start with the API target URL when active testing is needed.
Content mode accepts actual OpenAPI JSON/YAML text with a required full HTTP(S) hostOverride
and an explicitly enabled shared filesystem; it cannot read chat attachments automatically.
Returns plain text containing definition type, source kind, and import status. URL/file mode
also includes source and engine messages; content mode withholds contents, internal paths,
and raw engine warning text. Review warnings before proceeding.
Invalid inputs, blocked URLs, and ZAP API failures raise errors.

definitionType.description: Required definition format: openapi (OpenAPI/Swagger), graphql (GraphQL schema), or soap (WSDL). Case-insensitive.

sourceKind.description: Required source mode: url for a definition ZAP downloads, file for a definition on ZAP's filesystem, or content for self-contained OpenAPI JSON/YAML text. Content is OpenAPI-only and requires configured shared staging. Case-insensitive.

source.description: Required definition URL, ZAP-readable file path, or actual JSON/YAML text when sourceKind=content. A chat attachment name, client-local path or inaccessible resource URI is not definition content. Content imports are bounded to 1 MiB and reject external references and YAML aliases.

endpointUrl.description: Required for graphql: HTTP(S) API endpoint to test, for example https://api.example.com/graphql; must be reachable by ZAP and allowed by server URL policy. Ignored for openapi and soap.

hostOverride.description: OpenAPI target override allowed by server URL policy. Required full HTTP(S) URL for content imports, for example https://api.example.com/v1. URL/file imports also allow authority/path with an explicit host, for example api.example.com:9090/v1; omit only for trusted definition-derived targets constrained by ZAP egress controls. Ignored for graphql and soap.

tools.name: zap_report_read
tools.description: Preview a generated report artifact through MCP after zap_report_generate. If truncated, use zap_report_read_chunk to retrieve the complete artifact in bounded pages.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters to return (optional, default: 20000, max: 200000)

tools.name: zap_report_generate
tools.description: Generate a human-shareable report artifact using guided defaults. Use this after passive scan backlog drains when you want an export or handoff artifact; use findings summary/details for interactive triage.

baseUrl.description: Optional absolute HTTP(S) origin or path prefix. Supplying it publishes a target-scoped report; omission explicitly includes the full ZAP session.

format.description: Optional report format: html for human reading or json for machine processing

theme.description: Optional light/dark theme for full-session HTML. Target-scoped HTML uses the standard template's default appearance; JSON has no theme.

tools.name: zap_attack_stop
tools.description: Stop a guided active-scan operation.

operationId.description: Guided attack operation ID returned by zap_attack_start

tools.name: zap_scan_history_get
tools.description: Read one scan history or release-evidence entry by ID.

tools.name: zap_passive_scan_status
tools.description: Get passive scan backlog and completion status.

tools.name: zap_report_read_chunk
tools.description: Retrieve a generated UTF-8 report in bounded JSON pages. Append content in order, follow nextOffset until endOfFile=true, and supply the first page's artifactSha256 as expectedSha256 on later pages. Offsets and maxChars count Unicode code points. Artifacts are limited to 50 MiB; the SHA-256 identifies the full original UTF-8 file.

maxChars.description: Maximum Unicode code points in this page (default: 20000, maximum: 200000)

expectedSha256.description: Full artifact SHA-256 from the first page; subsequent pages reject a changed report

tools.name: zap_crawl_stop
tools.description: Stop a guided crawl operation.

operationId.description: Guided crawl operation ID returned by zap_crawl_start

tools.name: zap_auth_session_validate
tools.description: Validate a prepared guided auth session before authenticated crawl or attack flows.

tools.name: zap_crawl_start
tools.description: Start a guided crawl for a target host or root URL. The server decides direct versus queued execution from deployment topology. Use strategy=http for traditional server-rendered sites, strategy=client for JavaScript-driven apps using Client Spider, or strategy=browser for the existing AJAX Spider API. strategy=auto starts with HTTP Spider; only an unauthenticated direct HTTP start failure triggers AJAX fallback. Auto does not detect JavaScript coverage. Client Spider requires the Client Side Integration add-on and headless Firefox. Prepared browser authentication sessions require strategy=client; prepared HTTP form-login sessions require http or auto.

targetUrl.description: Target host or root URL to crawl, for example https://app.example.com or https://app.example.com/admin

strategy.description: Optional crawl strategy: auto starts HTTP (unauthenticated direct mode alone falls back to AJAX on HTTP start failure), http for traditional link discovery, client for Client Spider on JavaScript-driven apps, or browser for the AJAX Spider API. Auto does not detect JavaScript coverage.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key used only when guided execution selects queued mode; ignored in direct mode.

authSessionId.description: Optional session ID from zap_auth_session_prepare. Use a kind=browser profile with strategy=client, or a kind=form profile with http/auto. The browser strategy means AJAX Spider and rejects authSessionId.

tools.name: zap_passive_scan_wait
tools.description: Wait for the passive scan backlog to drain before reading findings or generating reports.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait before returning (1-300, optional, default: 60)

pollIntervalMs.description: Polling interval in milliseconds (1-10000, optional, default: 1000)

tools.name: zap_scan_history_export
tools.description:
Export scan history as inline JSON text for internal evidence processing; no export file is created.
Use zap_scan_history_list for a readable listing, zap_scan_history_release_evidence for a summary bundle,
or zap_scan_history_customer_handoff for a customer-facing summary.
Returns version, generatedAt, retentionDays, entryCount, and entries containing scan/job/artifact records,
including internal IDs, paths, and metadata; review before sharing.
Only records accessible to the caller in the current workspace are included, newest first.
Omitted or blank filters select all accessible records; supplied filters combine with AND.
The snapshot is capped by limit, has no pagination, and returns an empty entries array when nothing matches.
It does not start scans or contact targets. Querying may delete expired stored ledger entries under
the configured retention policy; it does not refresh scan outcomes from ZAP.

evidenceType.description: Optional case-insensitive exact type filter: scan_job, scan_run, or report_artifact. Omit or leave blank for all types.

status.description: Optional case-insensitive exact status filter: queued, running, succeeded, failed, or cancelled for jobs; started for direct scans; generated for reports. Omit or leave blank for all statuses.

target.description: Optional case-insensitive substring of the target URL, target display name, or artifact location, e.g. api.example.com. Omit or leave blank for all targets.

limit.description: Positive maximum number of entries. Omission uses the configured export maximum (500 by default); larger values are capped to that maximum. Zero or negative values are rejected.

tools.name: zap_crawl_status
tools.description: Get status for a guided crawl operation.

operationId.description: Guided crawl operation ID returned by zap_crawl_start

tools.name: zap_scan_history_customer_handoff
tools.description: Generate a customer-safe Markdown handoff summary from scan history without raw internal IDs, backend references, workspace IDs, or metadata.

handoffName.description: Optional release, pilot, or customer handoff label included in the summary

target.description: Optional evidence-window selector used internally; the raw selector is never echoed in customer-facing output

limit.description: Optional maximum entries to review, bounded by server configuration

tools.name: zap_findings_details
tools.description: Drill into findings after reading the summary. Requires a nonblank target baseUrl covered by scan evidence visible to the caller. By default this returns grouped details for matching alerts. Set includeInstances=true when you need bounded raw alert occurrences with concrete URLs, params, evidence, or attack samples.

baseUrl.description: Required nonblank target base URL covered by scan evidence visible to the caller

pluginId.description: Optional plugin ID filter when you already know the ZAP alert/plugin identifier to inspect

alertName.description: Optional alert name filter when you want one alert family only

includeInstances.description: Optional true to include bounded raw instances with concrete URLs and evidence; false returns grouped detail blocks

limit.description: Optional instance limit used only when includeInstances is true
